text:
noah: putting this here — support raised a request from MegaRetail. They run Dedicated and want streaming chat + function/tool calls forwarded to their webhook. Key ask: partial, structured tool output frames (JSON objects) delivered incrementally so their frontend can render updates and avoid 10s client timeouts. Ticket: https://megaretail.example/t/7789

sana: thanks. is this a bug or a feature request? are they blocked in production today?

noah: feature request but blocking a rollout for one of their customer-facing features. Currently they poll and see long delays; they'd prefer first partial within 200ms, and tool outputs as soon as model invokes them.

devin: quick engineering read: we already stream tokens for hosted/console responses. Forwarding structured tool outputs to webhooks as independent frames needs: (a) a stable frame envelope with type and seq, (b) a delivery guarantee and short-lived resume cursor, (c) opt-in mode for dedicated projects so we don't change global hosted behavior, (d) safe replay semantics for non-idempotent tools.

harper: propose minimal webhook frame prototype: single-line NDJSON frames where frame envelope contains metadata. Example: {"t":"tool_frame","tool":"inventory_check","id":"f_89a","seq":3,"cursor":"c_9xZ","body":{"status":"partial","items":45}}
This keeps it backward-compatible with our current chunk stream and adds cursor + explicit frame id.

olivia: product asks: what are the acceptance criteria for a pilot vs GA? MegaRetail wants this in Dedicated within 6 weeks for a pilot. They also asked for: no duplicate side-effects on retry, clear docs, and metrics.

sana: draft acceptance criteria idea: - Pilot: opt-in Dedicated flag; NDJSON tool frames with seq+cursor; resume cursor TTL=60s; at-least-once delivery with client dedupe guidance; basic SDK snippet; observable metrics (frames/success/dedupe events). - GA: documented SDKs for hosted + dedicated, server-side resume rehydrate for long reconnects, SLA on first-frame latency, and a replay-safe wrapper for tool invocations.

devin: rough effort estimate: pilot emitter + webhook forwarder + short-lived cursor store = 2 engs * 3 weeks. Server-side resume + KV rehydrate = +2-3 sprints and infra (checkpoint store + retention). Replay-safe wrappers depend on tool surface — might need per-tool adapters.

harper: risk notes: - stateful resume introduces GC + storage costs - webhooks can be flaky; need backoff + DLQ pattern - dedupe/at-least-once means customers must handle idempotency; we can provide recommenders or wrappers but can't enforce for third-party tools.

noah: PM decision input: prioritize as P2 pilot (customer retention) and don't GA before we validate with MegaRetail. Owner suggestion: devin eng lead, sana PM.

olivia: pilot success metrics suggestion: 1) first-frame latency < 250ms 2) resume success rate > 90% 3) duplicate tool calls per-1000 < 1 4) MegaRetail's UX acceptance signoff after 2-week pilot.

sana: rollout checklist to move into backlog: spec doc + example NDJSON payloads, eng owner assigned, pilot infra spike plan, monitoring dashboard, rollback (disable opt-in flag), legal data review if frames contain PII.

devin: I'll draft the engineering proposal and include the sample NDJSON + delivery semantics. Planning spike to validate cursor store perf.

ci-bot: created PROD-1510 "dedicated-webhook-ndjson-tool-frames (MegaRetail pilot)" assigned to devin, labels: customer-pilot, p2, webhook-streaming

noah: thanks team. adding this as a discrete backlog card. please add any compliance or SRE concerns on the RFC. :wave:
